recastGate.plotDigitizationForbiddenUse: claiming nuisance-profiled rank, covariance, or exclusion in the two-coordinate model
recastGate.reason: Curves and aggregate limits do not retain the per-mode, per-mass likelihood and correlated efficiency/nuisance response needed to profile (A_2,c_WW) with arbitrary production and decay assumptions.

boundary.closed: The current official paper and publication page define the detector, fit and aggregate one-coupling result but do not expose the machine-readable likelihood packet required for an exact public two-coordinate recast.
boundary.scope: This is an availability statement for the inspected official surfaces on 25 October 2026, not a claim that the collaboration lacks the information or that no future release can supply it.
boundary.usefulNow: The public article fixes modes, mass range, fit family, resolution/lifetime dependence and systematic categories. These are sufficient to specify the request and build the theory-side forward model, but not to certify practical identifiability.
boundary.nextAction: Request or locate the six-item release packet; in parallel compute the complete W-associated and flavor-changing forward kernels so a released likelihood can be consumed without redefining the model after seeing data.
